```{=html}
<style>
#resources-page {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr;
  gap: 0;
  min-height: 85vh;
  border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  font-family: "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
#tree-panel {
  background: #f8f9fa;
  border-right: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.tree-category-label {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px 6px;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: #fff;
  margin: 6px 10px 4px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.tree-category-label.dw { background: #1a56db; }
.tree-category-label.pw { background: #0e9f6e; }
.tree-divider {
  height: 1px;
  background: #e0e0e0;
  margin: 10px 14px;
}
.tree-root { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
details.tree-group { padding: 0; }
details.tree-group > summary {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 7px 14px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; color: #333;
  list-style: none; user-select: none; transition: background 0.15s;
}
details.tree-group > summary:hover { background: #eef0f3; }
details.tree-group > summary::before {
  content: "▶"; font-size: 0.6rem; color: #aaa;
  transition: transform 0.2s; display: inline-block; width: 12px;
}
details.tree-group[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.tree-group ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 4px; }
.tree-leaf {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  padding: 5px 14px 5px 30px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.83rem; color: #444;
  border-left: 3px solid transparent; transition: background 0.12s, border-color 0.12s;
}
.tree-leaf:hover { background: #eef0f3; }
.tree-leaf.active { background: #e8f0fe; border-left-color: #1a56db; color: #1a56db; font-weight: 600; }
.tree-leaf.active.pw { background: #e3f9f1; border-left-color: #0e9f6e; color: #0e9f6e; }
details.tree-sub > summary {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  padding: 5px 14px 5px 26px; cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 500; color: #555;
  list-style: none; user-select: none;
}
details.tree-sub > summary:hover { background: #eef0f3; }
details.tree-sub > summary::before {
  content: "▶"; font-size: 0.58rem; color: #bbb;
  transition: transform 0.2s; display: inline-block; width: 10px;
}
details.tree-sub[open] > summary::before { transform: rotate(90deg); }
.tree-sub ul { padding: 0; }
.tree-sub .tree-leaf { padding-left: 50px; }

#viewer-panel { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff; }
#viewer-header {
  padding: 12px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  background: #fafafa; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; color: #333;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px;
}
#viewer-badge {
  font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px;
  border-radius: 20px; background: #1a56db; color: #fff;
}
#viewer-badge.pw { background: #0e9f6e; }
#pdf-frame { flex: 1; width: 100%; border: none; min-height: 80vh; background: #f5f5f5; display: none; }
#viewer-placeholder {
  flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  color: #bbb; gap: 12px; min-height: 80vh;
}
#viewer-placeholder .icon { font-size: 3.5rem; }
#viewer-placeholder p { font-size: 0.9rem; }
</style>

<div id="resources-page">

  <!-- TREE PANEL -->
  <div id="tree-panel">

    <!-- DIRECTED WORKS -->
    <div class="tree-category-label dw">📝 Directed Works (DW)</div>
    <ul class="tree-root">
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW1.pdf','DW1 — Introduction to Data Science','dw',this)">
        📄 DW 1 — Introduction
      </li>
      <details class="tree-sub" open>
        <summary>📁 DW 2 — Data Acquisition</summary>
        <ul>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW2_Part1.pdf','DW2 Part 1 — Data Acquisition','dw',this)">📄 Part 1</li>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW2_Part2.pdf','DW2 Part 2 — Data Acquisition','dw',this)">📄 Part 2</li>
        </ul>
      </details>
      <details class="tree-sub">
        <summary>📁 DW 3 — Exploratory Analysis</summary>
        <ul>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW3_part2.pdf','DW3 Part 2 — EDA','dw',this)">📄 Part 2</li>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW3_part3.pdf','DW3 Part 3 — EDA','dw',this)">📄 Part 3</li>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW3_part4.pdf','DW3 Part 4 — EDA','dw',this)">📄 Part 4</li>
        </ul>
      </details>
      <details class="tree-sub">
        <summary>📁 DW 4 — Visualization</summary>
        <ul>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW4_part1.pdf','DW4 Part 1 — Visualization','dw',this)">📄 Part 1</li>
          <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW4_part2.pdf','DW4 Part 2 — Visualization','dw',this)">📄 Part 2</li>
        </ul>
      </details>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/directed_works/DW5.pdf','DW5 — Experimental Design','dw',this)">
        📄 DW 5 — Experimental Design
      </li>
    </ul>

    <div class="tree-divider"></div>

    <!-- PRACTICAL WORKS -->
    <div class="tree-category-label pw">🧪 Practical Works (PW)</div>
    <ul class="tree-root">
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW1.pdf','PW1 — Getting Started','pw',this)">📄 PW 1 — Getting Started</li>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW2_Numpy.pdf','PW2 — NumPy','pw',this)">📄 PW 2 — NumPy</li>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW3.pdf','PW3 — Pandas','pw',this)">📄 PW 3 — Pandas</li>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW4.pdf','PW4 — EDA','pw',this)">📄 PW 4 — EDA</li>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW5.pdf','PW5 — Preprocessing','pw',this)">📄 PW 5 — Preprocessing</li>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW6.pdf','PW6 — Visualization','pw',this)">📄 PW 6 — Visualization</li>
      <li class="tree-leaf" onclick="loadPDF('/pdfs/courses/fds/practical_works/PW7.pdf','PW7 — Experimental Design','pw',this)">📄 PW 7 — Experimental Design</li>
    </ul>

  </div>

  <!-- VIEWER PANEL -->
  <div id="viewer-panel">
    <div id="viewer-header">
      <span id="viewer-badge">DW</span>
      <span id="viewer-title">Select a document from the tree</span>
    </div>
    <div id="viewer-placeholder">
      <div class="icon">📂</div>
      <p>Click any document in the tree to view it here</p>
    </div>
    <iframe id="pdf-frame"></iframe>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
var activeLeaf = null;
function loadPDF(url, label, type, el) {
  if (activeLeaf) { activeLeaf.classList.remove('active'); }
  el.classList.add('active');
  activeLeaf = el;
  var badge = document.getElementById('viewer-badge');
  badge.textContent = type === 'dw' ? 'DW' : 'PW';
  badge.className = type === 'pw' ? 'pw' : '';
  document.getElementById('viewer-title').textContent = label;
  var frame = document.getElementById('pdf-frame');
  document.getElementById('viewer-placeholder').style.display = 'none';
  frame.style.display = 'block';
  frame.src = url;
}
</script>
```
